parameters.body:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', max_tokens: 300, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Write a first-touch cold outreach email to a K-12 school administrator.

RULES:
- Under 90 words total
- 3rd grade reading level, write like you talk
- Short sentences. 2 sentences per paragraph max.
- NO links, NO attachments
- Only 1 question (the closing one)
- No clichés (no "hope this finds you well", "reaching out", "touching base")
- Bold nothing, no bullet points in the email itself
- Address the contact by their first name only

STRUCTURE:
Para 1: Hi [contact first name] - I noticed that [what their teachers/students are doing from the signals] and wanted to send you a quick note about Kindling.
Para 2: We help K-12 schools [one specific thing tied to their signals]. [one sentence with their specific numbers].
Para 3: Would you be open to a quick intro call this week?

Output exactly two lines, no other text:
SUBJECT: [under 10 words, specific to what this school did, no fluff]
BODY: [the full email — paragraphs separated by \n\n]

School: ' + $json.top_school.name + '
Contact: ' + $json.top_school.contact_name + ', ' + $json.top_school.contact_title + '
Location: ' + $json.top_school.city + ', ' + $json.top_school.state + '
Signals:
' + $json.top_school.reasons.map(r => '• ' + r).join('
') }] }) }}
